name: ACWA Power
scale_note: Its Jazlah (Jubail 3A) plant produces 600,000 cubic meters of desalinated water per day at 2.8 kWh per cubic meter, sold under Saudi Arabia's first PPP desalination deal in the Eastern region at 1.54 riyal per cubic meter.

name: Gradiant
scale_note: Founded in 2013 as an MIT spinout, Gradiant has grown to more than 900 employees internationally with over $392 million raised, and its MLD/ZLD systems recover up to 100 percent of liquid discharge from industrial wastewater.

name: IDE Technologies
scale_note: Builder and operator of large seawater reverse osmosis and thermal desalination plants; its Sorek 2 (Be'er Miriam) facility in Israel is expected to produce about 670,000 cubic meters of potable water per day when fully operational, and its Carlsbad, California plant produces 204,000 cubic meters per day, the largest desalination facility in the Americas when it was commissioned in 2015.

name: WABAG (VA Tech Wabag Ltd)
scale_note: Since 1995, WABAG has designed and built more than 60 desalination plants across 17 countries, together producing over 1.3 million cubic meters of freshwater a day.
